citations.text: I bought this game based on the exceptional reviews and because I enjoyed Harvest Moon. I was excited to jump into the game and try out the co-op feature but quickly found that it requires a massive commitment of your free time to make very little progress in the game. As someone who has a real-life job and housework etc to do, this game just doesn't work. The game is extremely grindy. I've spent 12 hours on it so far and made next to zero progress despite working hard in the game to make money, buy upgrades etc. Even the special events and relationships in the game were surprisingly boring and hollow and kept leaving me disappointed. I don't see the appeal of this game. I gave it a try, at no point did I feel like I was having fun, and I closed it. I read the reviews, but unhelpful gushing about how much they love about the game without saying what it was about the game they liked left me with no idea what the hell part of this game was supposed to be enjoyable, so whatever. Refunded.
